name: basics
description: Shofer's workspace basics in one plugin, each feature independently switchable: Checkpoints (per-task undo history in a shadow git repository, with diff and restore from the chat timeline), File Changes (a copy of every file the agent edits — before and after — with per-file diff, revert and accept above the chat input, plus the `get_changed_files` tool), and Worktrees (a git worktree per task under .worktrees/, the branch picker in the chat input, worktree management in Settings, .shofer/worktreeinclude seeding, and the merge/rebase/cleanup slash commands).
author: Shofer

commands.name: merge-worktree
commands.description: Merge this worktree's branch into the base branch with a merge commit.

commands.name: merge-worktree-cleanup
commands.description: Merge this worktree's branch into the base branch, then delete the branch and the worktree.

commands.name: rebase-worktree
commands.description: Rebase this worktree's branch onto the base branch and fast-forward merge it.

commands.name: rebase-worktree-cleanup
commands.description: Rebase and fast-forward merge this worktree's branch, then delete the branch and the worktree.

commands.name: dryrun-rebase-worktree
commands.description: Preview the conflicts a rebase onto the base branch would produce, without changing anything.

commands.name: worktree-status
commands.description: Report this worktree's branch status: ahead/behind, uncommitted changes and merge readiness.

checkpoints.description: Per-task undo history: snapshot the workspace into a shadow git repository before every file-mutating turn.

file-changes.description: Per-task file-change tracking: the changed-files panel above the chat input and the get_changed_files tool.

worktrees.description: Per-task git worktrees: each task runs in its own worktree under .worktrees/ unless you pick a branch.

checkpointInitTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for a task's shadow repository to initialize before giving up and disabling checkpoints for that task.

checkpointExcludePatterns.description: Extra newline-separated .gitignore-style patterns to exclude from checkpoints, on top of the built-in build-artifact/media/cache/LFS patterns.
